description: On a pole at the Viggen rest area on Riksväg 44 near the Tun exit between Trollhättan and Lidköping. The rest area was built in 2006. Wings and fin were taken from airframe 37958. Painted in bare silver to represent early uncamouflaged F 7 Viggens. Wore the marking 21-04 at an F 21 air display in 1981 and earlier codes 7-04 and 7-72.
